title: Medtronic tab initially renders the careportal [refresh problem]
body:
When importing settings into AAPS 3.0, the pump tab initially renders the old careportal (or some variant thereof). The workaround to this is to either:
a) reconfigure the pump
b) in the Profile builder, disable visibility for the Medtronic tab, and then re-enable it
![Screenshot_20211110-123704_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34991028/141166693-1b7afc2e-a8c0-4312-8846-a5b950b4645e.png)

Tested AAPS 3.0 B5

comments.body: is the app restarted aftr you import?

Yes--the phone reboot is initiated after granting file access permissions (as requested by the prompt), and then automatically restarts ("exiting application to apply settings") after importing settings, and the tab displays incorrectly.

At this point, if I reboot the phone a second time, the issue resolves itself (a third workaround).

----
Tested with 3.0 B5
